title: Test one bounded compiled-dimension change
objective: Test a small evidence-driven set of compiled launch dimensions for one fixed production shape.
preconditions: A measured occupancy, wave, or tile-quantization hypothesis
No stronger deletion/fusion mechanism is available
steps: Predict a short candidate set from the measured shape and hardware
Use paired full-boundary timing rather than autotuner self-time
Keep an exact-shape dispatch predicate and production fallback

acceptance.pass: One configuration wins beyond uncertainty for its owned shape and all fallbacks remain unchanged.
acceptance.no_win: The bounded set does not improve the production baseline.

stop_rule: A larger blind grid is not a new mechanism.
origin_evidence: o_proj_decode gained about 1.077x from a shape-specific compiled-dimension change against production.
